note: mcp_bridge_restart.rs drives a real daemon restart under one home (cc's RealDaemon::restart, d39d29eb): a graphql bridge call answers through the first daemon, the daemon is restarted (new serving pid, endpoint UNCHANGED -- the socket is fixed per home so pid is the witness), and a fresh bridge call re-resolves per request (hatch.rs resolves candidates on every call) and reaches the NEW daemon, its dispatch counter moving. A client that resolved once at startup would hit a dead socket; per-request resolution reaches the live one. Greened by ic 2026-08-31.
